findings.title: PersistTarget extends ReplicaTarget is not satisfied by a real PersistSession (no top-level documentId)
findings.fix: Do not extend ReplicaTarget; define PersistTarget as { applyUpdate(carrier): ApplyOutcome; flush(): Promise<void>; getState(): State } and use the explicit documentId parameter (sourced from session.identity.documentId).

findings.title: Redundant/conflicting document-id sources on the persisted import path
findings.where: design.md Public API importCapsuleIntoPersisted + Validation order step 8
findings.fix: Make the persisted helper single-source on its documentId parameter; remove the target.documentId reliance and state which source governs the identity check.

findings.title: State type used in public API without stating it is imported from @ghostsync/kit; strict/no-any path unspecified
findings.where: design.md Public API (PersistTarget.getState/PersistImportResult) + Files to create src/types.ts
findings.fix: State that State/ApplyOutcome and any Kit value types are imported/re-exported from @ghostsync/kit (never redefined), mirroring packages/persist/src/types.ts.

findings.title: Save-failure claim 'session state is error and recoverable' is only true on the open-session abort path, not for a ClosedError flush
findings.where: design.md Import helper semantics (REQ-CAP-009) + Error handling table; requirements.md AC-CAP-009-2
findings.fix: Scope the recoverable-save guarantee to an open-session armWriteAbortOnce TransactionAbortError; note a ClosedError flush on a terminated session is a separate programmer-error path.

findings.title: encodeCapsule assumes kind full without validating the input is full-state
findings.fix: Document that update MUST be exportState().bytes (kind full); optionally assert kind === 'full' at the boundary.

findings.title: createdAt validation via Date.parse admits non-ISO strings despite ISO-8601 claim
findings.fix: Either relax wording to 'parseable date string (informational)' or enforce a strict ISO round-trip/regex, consistently across requirements and design.

findings.title: AC-CAP-010-2 pins exact test counts (112/8/50/30) not confirmable from the tree
findings.fix: Assert suites pass 'unchanged from pre-change baseline' and capture the real baseline at implementation time rather than hard-coding counts.

findings.title: Shared fast-check test helper must not match the tests/**/*.test.ts include
findings.fix: Note that any shared test helper is named without the .test.ts suffix (mirror the Kit's tests/fc-report.ts) so it is not collected as an empty suite.
